items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: There was one guy that had a band, Lil Joe. Lil Joe had a band that played but his band would travel all around northern Louisiana.

ctx.x: I guess my question is why did they have to bring a band in, people from New Orleans, to play?

Oh they didn't have any, we didn't have any bands out there. There was one guy that had a band, Lil Joe. Lil Joe had a band that played but his band would travel all around northern Louisiana. And there were a couple more bands that were from Alexandria, but they were older than us and they had a bigger name than us. And they played a lot. They were older than us. And they were, they were making about $20 a week a piece. Yeah. See when you get, when you get a, now like this band, Thomas Jefferson, Adam Lambert…
